svg.text: A1 prototype • CAD renders • not a fabrication release • 2026-10-24
Both J17 contacts are positive power paths. Neither is ground.
Verify ON closes the loop and OFF opens it.
J1 supply: pin 1 = +24 V, pin 2 = 0 V/GND (−). Disconnect the source before assembly. OFF does not isolate the input terminal or every external signal.
